percentile_method: nearest rank; p99 is the maximum of 50 samples per point
session_policy: fresh direct Device and per-job HMX power for every sample; warmups checked and excluded
sample_order: seeded shuffle of all case/depth/mode points in each round
timing_scope: HMX windows include clear/load/store and helper/loop/timer costs; exclude packing, copying, conversion and host work

resident_slopes.method: least squares of median HMX ticks per transaction versus depth count
resident_slopes.basis: ticks per 32-depth block; batch2 consumes two blocks per packet
